notes: ACCESS: same as Bestsellers - curl_cffi chrome131 direct, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow. NAV DISCOVERY: filtered the 465-URL category sitemap for clearance/outlet/sale/discount terms; specifically checked for a dedicated 'Outlet' section per task instruction (HSN/QVC Group properties are known for one) - tried https://www.ballarddesigns.com/outlet/ (404) and https://outlet.ballarddesigns.com/ (DNS does not resolve) - confirmed no separate Outlet subsite/subdomain exists; the site's markdown-merchandising section lives entirely under /sale/. SALE-VS-CLEARANCE TEST (the critical judgment call): the URL slug is /sale/ throughout, which would normally be a yellow flag, so every candidate was opened via ?templateInfo=true to read the site's own pageHeader (the h1/page-title text the storefront itself renders) rather than trusting the URL. Every single /sale/* node's pageHeader explicitly says 'Clearance ...' (e.g. pageHeader='Clearance', pageTitle='Clearance by Category - Discount Furniture, Decor' for /sale/; pageHeader='Clearance Furniture' for /sale/category/furniture/; pageHeader='Clearance Outdoor', 'Clearance Bed & Bath', 'Clearance Decor & More', 'Clearance Mirrors & Art', 'Clearance Lighting & Light Fixtures', 'Clearance Rugs & Drapery', 'Clearance Fabric by the Yard', 'Clearance Holiday' for their respective department pages; pageHeader='New to Clearance', pageTitle='New Clearance Recently Added to Sale' for /sale/category/new-clearance/). This is the site's own taxonomy unambiguously self-labeling every one of these as Clearance, not a generic/temporary Sale campaign - so all qualify with no ambiguity flag needed. Counts pulled the same way as Bestsellers, via UnbxdAPI numberOfProducts for each page's own categoryId. ALIAS CHECK: /sale/category/all/ resolves to the SAME categoryId (10001) and same pageHeader/qty as the parent /sale/ - true alias, kept only the canonical /sale/ row, not duplicated. EXCLUDED: /sale/couponspage/ (found in sitemap) - opened via templateInfo, pageHeader is blank/whitespace, categorySubType is None (not ProductGridView) - this is a coupon-code landing page, not a product listing; confirmed by its metaKeywords ('ballard designs coupons, rebate, discounts, deals, offers, promotions'). STRUCTURE: /sale/ (qty 406, pageTitle 'Clearance by Category') is a genuine grouping page whose own grid also returns products, with 9 real department children plus 1 'New to Clearance' recency child - all distinct site-defined nodes, not invented. Kept parent + all children per the shared-engine sub-structure rule; child counts don't sum exactly to the parent total (candidate department nodes ~420 combined vs parent 406) which is expected/normal overlap-and-different-grid behavior, not an error requiring dedup.
